title: Xebo Tweaks
description:
A mod that adds some crafting recipes, including Name Tag, Saddle, All Horse Armor, and the EXP Bottle.

This mod also adds advancements and others.
body:
This is a mod that adds many different crafting recipes and advancements that aren't in the game currently.

All of the Overpowered recipes like the Trident and Elytra are for people who don't like exploring for that item, like Tridents instead of grinding all day for drowneds they can go to a Ocean Monument and kill some guardians, and the Elytra instead of finding a ship in the End they can grab some phantom membranes, popped chorus fruit, and a crying obsidian, and the Enchanted Golden Apple for instead of visiting many structures they can instead collect 8 gold blocks and an apple, just like the old recipe!

**Crafting:**
- Name Tags
- Saddles
- EXP Bottles
- All Horse Armor
- Chainmail Armor
- Bells
- Enchanted Golden Apples
- Tridents
- Chorus Fruit
- Chorus Flowers
- Elytra
- End Stone
- Cobblestone
- Lily Pads
- Vines
- Nether Wart

**Advancements:**
- Dirty (Place All 3 Types of Dirt)
- Electrifying! (Place a Lightning Rod)
- What to Name? (Obtain a Name Tag)
- Fishing for a Fork (Obtain a Trident)
- Well, You Did It (Beat the Warden)

**New Items:**
- Stone Pebbles (Crafted from 1 Cobblestone)
- Sensory Pickaxe (Dropped from the Warden)
